newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four police injured in Colombia bomb attack.
newsitem.headline: Four police injured in Colombia bomb attack.

text.p: Four policemen and one civilian were injured on Friday in a pre-dawn bomb attack on a police station in northwest Colombia, authorities said.

Police said the dynamite attack was carried out shortly before 5 a.m. (1000 GMT) in Bello, a working-class district on the northern outskirts of Medellin, Colombia's third largest city and its most violent.

The bomb, which reduced the two-story police station to rubble, was hurled by unidentified assailants who sped off aboard a motorcycle and a taxi, police spokesmen said. They added that four police agents and a civilian were treated in area hospitals for minor injuries after the attack.
A total of 5,245 people were murdered in Medellin last year -- a daily average of more than 14 -- according to official police statistics.
